structured_output.hypothesis: In North Sea plaice, Fulton's condition factor K = 100*W/L^3 computed from individual fish rises with length to a single interior maximum near 30 cm (the onset of maturity) and declines at larger sizes.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Using individual plaice (Pleuronectes platessa) with length and weight, binned in 2-cm classes with n>=30 per bin, the mean K in the 25-35 cm class is the maximum bin (or within 2% of it), the peak bin center lies within 30 ± 5 cm, mean K at lengths <20 cm is at least 3% lower than the peak, and mean K at lengths >45 cm is at least 3% lower than the peak (with a negative Spearman correlation between K and length above the peak, p<0.05).
structured_output.fail_criterion: The claim is refuted if the K-vs-length curve is monotonic or flat (peak bin at the smallest or largest size class, or all bins within 3% of each other), or if the peak bin center lies outside 25-35 cm, or if K at >45 cm is not at least 3% below the peak.
structured_output.interpretation: Thompson's k = W/L^3 is Fulton's condition factor (scaled by 100 for convenience). 'Size of sexual maturity' is taken as about 30 cm total length (the author's figure), without testing maturity directly. Thompson's data were pooled commercial or market plaice; the modern test uses survey-caught individual fish, and K is averaged within length classes. Seasonal and sex effects add noise, so quarter-pooled data are used. Weight is whole wet weight as recorded in the survey.

dataset.name: DATRAS (Database of Trawl Surveys): North Sea International Bottom Trawl Survey (NS-IBTS) exchange data
dataset.publisher: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES)
dataset.why_it_fits: DATRAS provides downloadable individual-fish biological records (HL/CA exchange format) for the North Sea surveys, including plaice (species code 127143 / Aphia ID) with length (cm), individual weight (g), sex and maturity stage. This allows computing K=100*W/L^3 per fish, binning by length and locating the peak. Fields used: LngtClass, IndWgt, Sex, Maturity, Quarter, Year, Valid_Aphia. Note that the CA records with IndWgt are the individual-weight records.
